theme_central: A ring structure around two narratives (Musa, then Adam), each framed by instructions to the Prophet and followed by an evocation of the Day of Judgment.
sources_note: Ring structure confirmed (Wikipedia Ta-Ha, in English) with precise landmarks: Musa's calling v.10, the exodus/Red Sea v.77, the golden calf v.88, Adam's fall v.120.

branches.title: Opening, the call at the bush
branches.resume: The Qur'an not sent down to cause distress; Musa sees the fire and receives the divine call.

children.t: The Qur'an not sent down to cause distress, Allah knows the secret and what is even more hidden
Musa sees the fire, the divine call: "I am Allah, there is no god but Me"

branches.title: The signs, the mission to Pharaoh
branches.resume: The staff and the shining hand, the mission extended to Harun, sent to Pharaoh.

children.t: The staff and the shining hand, Musa asks for Harun's help
Reminder of Musa's childhood, the basket on the river
Sent to Pharaoh with gentle words, the debate: "Who is your Lord?"

branches.title: The sorcerers' challenge, the exodus
branches.resume: Confrontation with the sorcerers, their conversion, then the exodus and Pharaoh's drowning.

children.t: Challenge issued to the sorcerers, confrontation
The sorcerers' conversion despite Pharaoh's threat
The exodus, the crossing of the sea, Pharaoh's drowning

branches.title: The golden calf, the Samiri
branches.resume: Blessings recalled, Musa's anger at the golden calf made by the Samiri.

children.t: Blessings recalled, the manna and the quails
Musa's anger, the golden calf made by the Samiri
Harun's warning ignored, confrontation with the Samiri

branches.title: Eschatological reminder
branches.resume: The Qur'an as a reminder, the Trumpet, everything submitting to Ar-Rahman.

children.t: This Qur'an as a reminder, the fate of those who turn away from it
Question about the mountains, the Trumpet, submission to Ar-Rahman
The Qur'an in Arabic, not to hasten in its recitation

branches.title: The account of Adam, the fall
branches.resume: The forgotten covenant, Iblis's temptation, the fall and the promise of guidance.

children.t: Covenant forgotten by Adam, Iblis's temptation, the fall, the promise of guidance
A narrow life for those who turn away from the reminder

branches.title: Closing
branches.resume: Lesson of the destroyed generations, patience and prayer as support for the Prophet.

children.t: Lesson of the destroyed generations, patience, prayer as support
